qs.q: During a carotid endarterectomy, the surgeon identifies the hypoglossal nerve crossing superficial to the external and internal carotid arteries. Which triangle of the neck contains this surgical field?
qs.e: The carotid triangle is bounded by the sternocleidomastoid, omohyoid, and digastric muscles and contains the carotid vessels.
